import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: 1000 Cameras Overview', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_colors = {'Full Frame': '#e74c3c', 'APS-C': '#3498db', 'Micro 4/3': '#2ecc71'}
for sensor in df['sensor_type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=sensor, c=sensor_colors.get(sensor, '#95a5a6'), s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Average Price by Brand (Top 10 brands by count)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10).index
brand_avg_price = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)].groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis(range(0, 256, 25))
bars = ax2.barh(brand_avg_price.index, brand_avg_price.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Top 10 Brands', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# Plot 3: Camera Count by Body Type and 4K Video Capability
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
body_4k = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
body_4k.columns = ['No 4K', 'Has 4K']
body_4k.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Camera Count by Body Type & 4K Video Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='4K Video')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 4: Weight vs Price Distribution by Body Type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', ax=ax4, palette='Set2')
ax4.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
